title: “CARS” Children’s Shoes Sold Exclusively at Wal-Mart Recalled by Pagoda International Footwear Ltd. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The shoe has four decorative wheels that can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 73,000 distributed in the United States and 18,000 distributed in Canada.

title: Ross Stores Recalls Folding Patio Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The side supports on these chairs can splinter when weight is placed on them, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 730.

title: Women's Shoes Recalled by Wal-Mart Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Heels on the shoes can easily detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000 pairs.

title: GE Recalls Ranges Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The wiring in the rear of the range can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 28,000.

title: Pacifiers Recalled by Healthtex Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifiers failed to meet federal safety standards. The nipples can separate from the base easily, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 40,000.

title: Polaris Industries Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel lines on the snowmobiles can make contact with one another, which could result in a fuel leak. This can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,200.

title: Simplicity Play Yards Recalled by Various Retailers Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards
summary: One or more rails can collapse unexpectedly, posing a fall or entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 25,000.

title: Stanley and Solarwide Industrial Recall Stud Sensors Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The stud sensor can fail to calibrate properly and detect AC electrical wires behind the wall, posing a shock hazard to the user. Units: About 78,000.

title: Atico International USA Recalls Coffeemakers Sold Exclusively At Walgreens Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These coffeemakers can ignite due to an electrical failure, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500,000.

title: Best Buy Announces the Recall of Certain Insignia 26-Inch Flat-Panel LCD Televisions Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The television's power supply can fail, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,300.

title: Best Buy Announces the Recall of Certain Rocketfish Universal Portable Power Sources Due to Fire Hazard
summary: While charging the battery, the power source can unexpectedly ignite, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Faulty Installation Instructions Prompt RadioShack Corp. Recall of Electrical Switches; Shock Hazard to Consumers
summary: The wiring diagram on the switch's package is incorrect. The Neutral and Line notation is reversed, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,000.

title: Radio Transmitters for Model Aircrafts Recalled by Horizon Hobby Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The defective radio transmitters can cause model airplanes and helicopters they control to fall from the sky while in flight and crash into bystanders or property. title: SunKids Convertible Cribs Recalled by Suntech Enterprises Due to Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The sides of the crib are made of mesh that expands, creating a gap between the side and the crib's mattress if it's not zipped into place, or a gap between the side and an added mattress. title: Brave Products Reannounces Recall of Log Splitters; Additional Incidents Prompt Urgent Warning of Amputation Hazard
summary: The log splitter's hydraulic cylinders can have defective rod retention, causing the seals to leak and the rods to detach. This can result in serious injury to the operator, as the rod can rapidly and unexpectedly extend the splitting wedge. Units: About 8,000 units were recalled in July 2007; 4,000

title: Lakeshore Learning Materials Recalls Children's Toy Boxes Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The head of the stuffed butterfly toy can detach from the body, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 4,000.

title: Women's Chenille Robes Recalled by Blair Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Some robes fail to meet federal flammability requirements and present a risk of serious burns to consumers if they are exposed to an open flame. Units: About 162,000.

title: Toaster Oven/Broilers Recalled by Haier America Due to Burn or Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: Electrical connections in the toaster oven/broilers can become loose, posing electrical shock and burn hazards. Units: About 106,000.

title: SportsPlay Equipment Recalls Playgrounds Due to Violation of Lead Paint Ban
summary: The handrails and posts on the playground contain high levels of lead paint. Lead can be toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 540.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cable stop on the bicycle can loosen, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the bike. Units: About 3,000.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Serious Fall Hazard
summary: The handlebars can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 14,000.

title: Bush Hog Off-Road Utility Vehicles Recalled Due to Loss of Speed Control; Cash Incentive Offered
summary: The utility vehicle's throttle cable can lock in freezing temperatures. This can cause the engine not to return to idle when the driver takes his or her foot off the accelerator pedal, posing a risk of loss of vehicle control and injury to the driver and passenger. Units: About 850 units.

title: Fitness Balls Recalled by EB Brands Due to Fall Hazard; New Assembly Instructions Provided
summary: An overinflated fitness ball can unexpectedly burst while in use, causing the user to fall to the floor. Units: About 3 million.

title: Toy Maracas Recalled by Tupperware U.S. Due to Choking and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The maracas can break and expose small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. In addition, the handle poses a suffocation hazard to young children. Units: About 44,000.

title: Senseo One-Cup Coffeemakers Recalled by Philips Consumer Lifestyle Due to Burn Hazard
summary: An electrical fault and the build-up of calcium from hard or medium water can cause an obstruction in the coffeemaker. If this happens, the boiler can burst, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 155,000.

title: Gap Recalls Children’s Coats; Toggles Can Break and Detach Posing Choking Hazard
summary: The coats have toggle fasteners that could break and detach from the coat, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 19,200 in the U.S. and 3,900 in Canada.

title: Jardine Announces Second Recall Expansion of Cribs Sold by Babies'R'Us; Cribs Pose Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The wooden crib slats can break, creating a gap, which can pose an entrapment and strangulation hazard to infants and toddlers. Units: About 96,000 (320,000 units were previously recalled in June 2008 and 56,450 units were recalled in January 2009).

title: Popcorn Machines Recalled by DTX International Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The heating element of the popcorn machine's warming deck can remain on after being switched off. This poses a burn hazard to users. Units: About 220.

title: Pumpkin Patch Recalls Hooded Girls' Raincoats with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The raincoats have a drawstring through the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 800.

title: Dinosaur Play Sets Recalled by DND Imports Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the monkey figure contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 50.

title: Hair Dryers Recalled by Universalink International Trading Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device to prevent electrocution if the hair dryer falls into water. Immersion protection devices, which prevent electrocution, are required by industry standards for all electric hand-held hair dryers. Units: About 3,000.

title: HMI Industries Recalls Floor Cleaners Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled cleaners' wiring can overheat, causing electrical arcing and melting. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 44,000.

title: Under Armour Recalls Athletic Cups Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The cups can break if hit, posing a risk of serious injury hazard to athletes. Units: About 211,000.

title: Leg Curl Fitness Machines Recalled by Paramount Fitness Due To Crushing Hazard
summary: A consumer's hand can become caught between the cylindrical counter weight and the frame of the fitness machine, posing a crushing hazard that can result in lacerations and finger amputation. Units: About 150.
